newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sao Paulo 97/98 orange crop 405 mln boxes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sao Paulo 97/98 orange crop 405 mln boxes.

text.p: Orange production in the Brazilian state of Sao Paulo is forecast to reach 405 million 40.8 kg boxes in 1997/98, said the Brazilian Association of Citrus Exporters (Abecitrus).

The first estimate for the 1997/98 season compares with a final figure for the 1996/97 crop of 363 million boxes. Of the 405 million boxes to be harvested this year, 295 million will be used for processing and the remaining 110 million for the fresh fruit market, Abecitrus said in a statement.
In 1996/97, 270 million boxes were processed, while the fresh fruit market absorbed 93 million boxes.

Abecitrus forecast that production would be 2.25 boxes per tree against 2.10 boxes in 1996/97. The number of fruit-bearing trees is forecast at 180 million this year against 172.7 million last season.
